• **Choose* (used in present tense) *-** to select freely and after consideration

questions.question: A work is done by P & Q, Q & R, and R & P in 12, 15, and 20 days, respectively. How many days will P alone take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:-** Work done by P & Q = 12 days, Q & R = 15 days, and R & P = 20 days

**To find:-** Time taken by P alone to complete the work

**Formula used:-** work done = Efficiency × time taken

Calculation**:-** According to the question,

⇒P & Q = 12 days

⇒Q & R = 15 days

⇒R & P = 20 days

**Let the total work be the LCM(12, 15, 20)**

⇒Total work = 4 × 3 × 5 = 60 units

The efficiency can be calculated by using (work done)/(time taken),

⇒Effciency of P & Q = {60over12} = 5

⇒Effciency of Q & R = {60over15} = 4

⇒Effciency of R & P = {60over20} = 3

Let the efficiency of P, Q, and R be p, q, and r

⇒p + q = 5, q + r = 4 and r + p = 3

In solving the above three equations,

The efficiency of P, Q, and R will be 2, 3, and 1 respectively

So, If P works alone to complete the work then the time can be calculated by using the formula, work done = Efficiency × time taken

⇒60 = 2 × Time taken

⇒30 = Time taken

**The time taken by the P to complete the work is 30 days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Time Work Efficiency

Time is taken by P to complete the work alone

⇒ 30

**∴ The answer is 30 days.**

questions.question: A batsman in his 11th inning scores 88 runs, thereby increasing his average score by 4. What is his average after the 11th innings?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New Average = Runs in current innings − (Previous innings × Increase in average)

Runs scored in current (11th) innings = 88 runs

Total runs used to increase the average of previous 10 innings = 10 × 4 = 40 runs

New Average = 88 − 40 = 48 runs

**∴ The correct answer is 48 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Score in 11th innings = 88 runs

Increase in average score = 4 runs

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6518bb734d59765f33f149097be9545929948d9801b2e856b11fce8c5d81046.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the average score after 10 innings be x.

⇒ Total runs after 10 innings = 10 × x = 10x

⇒ Total runs after 11 innings = 10x + 88

⇒ New average after 11 innings = x + 4

⇒ (10x + 88) ÷ 11 = x + 4

⇒ 10x + 88 = 11 × (x + 4)

⇒ 10x + 88 = 11x + 44

⇒ 11x − 10x = 88 − 44

⇒ x = 44

⇒ Average after 11th innings = x + 4 = 44 + 4 = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48 runs.**

• Tansen born in **Behata or Gwalior **was an Indian musician and poet who was an important figure in the North Indian tradition of **Hindustani classical music.**
 
• Born in a Hindu brahmin family, he learnt and perfected his art in the northwest region of **modern ****Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• Tansen was a **composer, musician and vocalist**, to whom many compositions have been attributed in northern regions of the** Indian subcontinent.**
 
• He was also an **instrumentalist who popularized and improved musical instruments**. He is among the most influential personalities in the North Indian tradition of Indian classical music, called **Hindustani***.

• ​The navratnas of Akbar's Court are **Abul Fazl, Abdul Rahim Khan-I-Khana, Birbal, Mulla Do-Piyaza Faizi, Raja Man Singh, Raja Todar Mal, Fakir Aziao-Din and Tansen.**
 
• **Abul Fazl, Akbar's friend **and counsellor, helped him frame the idea of** Sulh-i Kul **so that he could govern a society composed of many religions, cultures and castes.
 
• **Khanzada Mirza Khan Abdul Rahim, **generally known as simply Rahim and titled Khan-i-Khanan, was a poet who lived in India during the rule of Mughal emperor Akbar, who was his mentor.
 
• He was one of the nine main ministers in his court, known as the Navaratnas.
 
• Man Singh I, popularly known as **Mirza Raja Man Singh** was the **29th Kachwaha Rajput Raja of Amer, later known as Jaipur state, in Rajputana.**
